written_by: Claude, from the film's narration (Voice Transcribe) before running the pipeline. Not a trainer's list; test data only.

steps.text: Lead the air hose over the top of the left port and the lifeline over the right.
Lift the helmet by the side ports and set it over the diver's head onto the breastplate.
Turn the helmet into place until the faceplate faces forward and the scribed marks line up.
Drop the dumbbell into place, close the safety latch and secure it with a cotter pin.
Pass the air hose under the left arm and slip the air control valve eye pad over the long stud.
Reinstall the wing nut on the long stud and tighten it firmly with the wrench.
Lash down the air hose with two round turns of the halyard and tie off with a square knot.
Pass the lifeline under the right arm and lash it with two round turns and a square knot.
Close the exhaust valve all the way, then open it two and one half turns.
Close the faceplate, wind the wing nut finger tight and secure it with the wing nut wrench.
